# A USD bank, one deposit and one customer: something of each kind of block
# an export writes, so the place price blocks take among them can be seen.
#
# What this fixture produces: accounts Assets, Assets:Bank and Equity, a
# 100.00 USD deposit on 2026-01-04, and customer C-001.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_exporting_prices_is_asked_for.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: Equity
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

customer "C-001"
	name: "Example Customer"
	currency: USD

2026-01-04 * "Opening deposit"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 USD
	Equity -100.00 USD
